Web.Page.Me.Lore.Description: What Hoshi knows about you — how she should address you, your languages and interests.
Web.Audience.Guild.Label: Guild
Web.Audience.Guild.Description: Guild-wide features that apply to the whole Discord, regardless of audience.
Web.Audience.Alliance.Label: Alliance
Web.Audience.Alliance.Description: This guild is a single alliance's own Discord.
Web.Audience.Server.Label: Server
Web.Audience.Server.Description: This guild serves a whole STFC server.
Web.Audience.VeilGroup.Label: Veil Group
Web.Audience.VeilGroup.Description: This guild serves a veil group (a coalition of servers).
Web.Audience.Community.Label: Community
Web.Audience.Community.Description: A general Discord not tied to one alliance or server.
Web.Feature.Absences.Title: Absences
Web.Feature.Absences.Description: Members can report an upcoming absence; a kept-updated report of who's away posts to a public channel (and a staff-only copy) so leadership doesn't need to ask around.
Web.Feature.AiBackend.Title: AI Provider
Web.Feature.AiBackend.Description: The shared AI backend for this whole Discord: which language-model provider to use (Google Gemini or a local Ollama model), the API key, and the model choices. Every AI-powered feature — AI Chat, Member Lore, Announcement Forwarder — runs on this one configuration, so there's a single AI account per guild.
Web.Feature.AiChat.Title: AI Chat
Web.Feature.AiChat.Description: Lets the bot answer questions conversationally (via Google Gemini) in a configurable set of listen channels, grounded in a configurable set of knowledge channels. It can also build a genuine memory over time — notable community events, past conversations, and its own history with individual members — so answers feel like they come from someone who was actually there. Each guild uses its own Gemini API key.
Web.Feature.AlertsOptIn.Title: Alerts Opt-In
Web.Feature.AlertsOptIn.Description: Lets members opt in/out of a role that receives raid/shield alert pings, instead of everyone getting pinged by default.
Web.Feature.AllianceTournament.Title: Alliance Tournament Announcements
Web.Feature.AllianceTournament.Descripti: Advance-warning announcement when a new Alliance Tournament event is scheduled.
Web.Feature.AnnouncementForwarder.Title: Announcement Forwarder
Web.Feature.AnnouncementForwarder.Descri: Auto-translates official announcements (e.g. Scopely's English STFC news) posted in the source channels and reposts them as a branded translation in a destination channel, so members who don't read the source language still see them.
Web.Feature.Announcements.Title: Announcements
Web.Feature.Announcements.Description: Staff-published announcements with read tracking and unread reminders — usable by any audience, not alliance-specific.
Web.Feature.AnonymousMessaging.Title: Anonymous Messages
Web.Feature.AnonymousMessaging.Descripti: Members can send a message to leadership without revealing who sent it — usable by any audience.
Web.Feature.ClientRelease.Title: Client Release Announcements
Web.Feature.ClientRelease.Description: Announces when a new STFC game client version is released (Windows, macOS, Android, iOS) — relevant to any guild, not just alliances.
Web.Feature.CommandBridge.Title: Command Bridge
Web.Feature.CommandBridge.Description: The per-alliance "Kommandobrücke" hub messages (User/Staff/Friends) — the member- and staff-facing entry point most other features' buttons live on. Pick a channel per bridge and publish it; buttons appear as their features are enabled for this alliance.
Web.Feature.Diplomacy.Title: Diplomacy
Web.Feature.Diplomacy.Description: Tracks and announces this alliance's diplomatic status toward other alliances via /set-diplomacy.
Web.Feature.HoshiSay.Title: Hoshi Say
Web.Feature.HoshiSay.Description: Lets an admin have Hoshi compose a message in her own voice (via the AI backend) and post it as a plain chat line into the current channel — e.g. to comfort or address a member. The /hoshi-say command is limited to members holding the configured allowed role, which is the permission gate.
Web.Feature.InfiniteIncursions.Title: Infinite Incursions Announcements
Web.Feature.InfiniteIncursions.Descripti: Advance-warning announcement when a new Infinite Incursions event is scheduled.
Web.Feature.MemberLore.Title: Member Lore
Web.Feature.MemberLore.Description: The bot DM-interviews members (optional, opt-out) to learn who they are — how to address them, what they're into, funny stories about each other — so it can chat like a real member of the community.
Web.Feature.MemberOnboarding.Title: Member Onboarding
Web.Feature.MemberOnboarding.Description: Opt-in: DMs members that Player Assignment couldn't place automatically, asking them to confirm the bot's best guess or type their in-game player. Off by default — leave it off to resolve missing assignments only via Player Assignment's admin table, without ever DMing members.
Web.Feature.NicknameSync.Title: Nickname Sync
Web.Feature.NicknameSync.Description: Renames members' Discord nicknames to match their linked in-game player, optionally prefixing a server and/or alliance tag (e.g. [EU164][XYZ] Name) to disambiguate foreign players.
Web.Feature.OpsLevelRoles.Title: Ops Level Roles
Web.Feature.OpsLevelRoles.Description: Assigns each member one of seven Discord roles matching their current STFC Ops Level tier (G1-G7), kept in sync from imported player data — one set of roles for the whole guild.
Web.Feature.PlayerLink.Title: Player Assignment
Web.Feature.PlayerLink.Description: Links members to their STFC player by matching Discord nicknames against the whole player catalog — which drives rank/ops/nickname role sync. Confident matches link automatically; everyone else you assign by hand on the member page. Never messages members.
Web.Feature.RaidAlerts.Title: Raid Alerts
Web.Feature.RaidAlerts.Description: Members can report an incoming raid via /raid, posting a public alert to whichever channel(s) are configured below.
Web.Feature.RankRoles.Title: Rank Roles
Web.Feature.RankRoles.Description: Assigns each member one of five Discord roles matching their current STFC in-alliance rank (Admiral/Commodore/Premier/Operative/Agent), kept in sync from imported player data — one set of roles for the whole guild.
Web.Feature.RoeViolationReports.Title: RoE Violation Reports
Web.Feature.RoeViolationReports.Descript: Members can report a suspected Rules of Engagement violation for staff to review.
Web.Feature.ServerStatus.Title: Server Status
Web.Feature.ServerStatus.Description: Announces when a tracked STFC server goes up/down or in/out of maintenance — relevant to any guild tracking a server, not just alliances.
Web.Feature.ServicesRoleSync.Title: Services Role Sync
Web.Feature.ServicesRoleSync.Description: Keeps the Territory Capture Services role in lock-step with the rank roles that can activate services (Admiral/Commodore): every alliance member holding either rank role gets the Services role, and anyone who no longer qualifies loses it. Needs Rank Roles and Territory Capture configured.
Web.Feature.ShieldReminders.Title: Shield Reminders
Web.Feature.ShieldReminders.Description: Members can set a reminder for when their shield expires; the bot pings them as it nears expiration and posts a public alert if it actually expires unrenewed.
Web.Feature.StfcNews.Title: STFC News
Web.Feature.StfcNews.Description: Pings this guild's Admin channel when a new Alliance Tournament or Infinite Incursions post appears on the official STFC blog, and lets admins confirm the event date so it feeds the relevant notify feature.
Web.Feature.TerritoryCapture.Title: Territory Capture
Web.Feature.TerritoryCapture.Description: Zone-slot and rank role sync, plus the weekly/daily Territory Capture digest summarizing owned zones and next capture times.
Web.Feature.Tickets.Title: Tickets
Web.Feature.Tickets.Description: Members can open a private support thread with staff via the hub button — usable by any audience.
